name: BenchDrop-seq
summary: Single-cell long-read RNA-seq without a microfluidics instrument: PIP-seq capture plus Oxford Nanopore sequencing on a standard lab bench.

name: Bagpiper
summary: Turns barcoded Nanopore reads into isoform-by-cell count matrices: cell barcode and UMI error correction, alignment to the transcriptome, removal of PCR duplicates, and EM resolution of molecules that fit several isoforms.
install:
git clone --branch 0.1.0 https://github.com/avisrilab/bagpiper.git
cd bagpiper && cargo build --release

name: Matisse
tagline: R package · per-cell splicing (PSI) in Seurat
summary: Computes percent spliced in (PSI) for each splicing event in each cell and stores it as an assay in the Seurat object, next to gene expression. It works from long-read transcript counts, such as Bagpiper output, or from short-read splice-junction counts from STARsolo.

vignettes.title: Getting started with Matisse
vignettes.blurb: What PSI measures, the two input modes, and a quick start for long and short reads.

vignettes.title: Long-read workflow: transcript-based PSI
vignettes.blurb: From a transcript count matrix to PSI on the UMAP: build the object, filter, cluster, compare cell types and draw a sashimi plot.

vignettes.title: Short-read workflow: junction-based PSI
vignettes.blurb: From STARsolo splice junctions to PSI: build the event table, filter, map splicing on the UMAP and combine datasets.
